songs.name: Do Ya
幸福就是

Some of the lyrics, especially in the pre-choruses, are nice. I do feel like the song doesn't build to anything or have an obvious motion and it ends somewhat abruptly. Background is a little basic.

songs.comments: That voice is unbelievable, especially at the end after the key change. So hauntingly beautiful. No clear problems with any other part of the song. I might actually prefer the live version though
songs.name: Opera No.2

songs.comments: Cute song. I don't like the part at the end where they reverse all the audio.
songs.name: Hidden In the Sand
Until I Found You

The "la biblioteca donde está" line in the middle is incredibly odd.

Lovely Day

songs.comments: I don't like some parts of the vocals (you can hear a lot of breath and air) but it's hard to deny that he's a very good singer. Lots of unique lyrics and the translation looks good. This song probably deserves a higher score.
songs.name: End of a day
The Nights
songs.comments: Could just be my headphones but the bass sounds so high and weak on this. Lyrics are pretty inspirational but the line "my father told me" isn't impactful enough for the place it's in

The way he forces out the last "ha" always stood out to me, not sure if I like it or I don't but it is interesting. The song almost feels unfinished, it feels like there should be another verse to me.
songs.name: Feel Good Inc.
The Crystal Ship
songs.comments: Putting different parts on different sides has an interesting effect but it does feel a bit lacking in the left ear. The lyrics sound poetic but are a bit nonsensical. I'm tempted to increase the vocal score because his voice has such a unique quality.
Lyrics are repetitive and crass but vocals are good. Bridge is pretty meh.
songs.name: Beep Beep
Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go
songs.comments: Maybe a little repetitive. Vocals in some spots are definitely better but not throughout the whole song. Cohesion and background at the end are better but also not throughout.

songs.name: Back In The U.S.S.R. - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: I like the bridge a lot

songs.name: Moonlight Drive
songs.comments: I'm a little biased with this song admittedly. I really like the line starting with "you reach your hand to hold me." The energy of the song increases throughout. One of the best implementations of having different parts in different ears.

songs.album: A Night At The Opera (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: '39 - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: Bridge is outstanding and the final chorus concludes the song well. Some of the sections have vocals that are so unique and flawless I can't begin to imagine executing them. The section between "I was wrong" and "Oh, I know" is genuinely mind blowing.
songs.name: When I Was Your Man

songs.comments: The "ee er" in the background sounds pretty funny. I don't love the autotune but the vocals are pretty good. Chorus is a bit repetitive. So is the background.
songs.album: Please Excuse Me for Being Antisocial
songs.name: The Box

songs.comments: Once again the chorus takes up so much of the song. I also just don't feel like the song has an overall direction
songs.name: Starman - 2012 Remaster

songs.name: Bewitched

Small nitpick, I don't like the overlap of the word pain between "heartache from the pain" to the chorus. Instrumental is very basic until the end and I kind of just don't like the sudden back and forth motion between the chorus and the verses.
songs.name: Believer

songs.artists: Jessie J, Ariana Grande, Nicki Minaj
songs.comments: Very impressive vocals actually. Lyrics are crass but that's very consistent with the rest of the song and some of the lines are pretty creative.

Crazy Little Thing Called Love - Remastered 2011

songs.name: Stereo Hearts (feat. Adam Levine)
My Sweet Lord - Remastered 2014

songs.name: Butterflies
味道
songs.comments: The background does build. I still would've preferred some new lyrics and a bit more of a climax.
Lyrics are a little basic but I didn't deduct. I deducted from flow because it was a bit repetitive and I didn't like how it just ended on another chorus.
songs.name: Shot In The Dark

songs.comments: Gun violence is a serious topic but I can't help but find some of the lyrics to be extremely funny. Chorus is a little repetitive, transition out of the instrumental is a bit sudden and the outro doesn't conclude very well.
songs.name: Put Out The Fire - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: I like how all the repeated verses have slightly different lyrics. Lyrics are a little cheesy.
songs.name: Perfect
Doo Wop (That Thing)
songs.comments: Reduced flow score because the song seems to meander a bit towards the end.
Maybe a few too many repeats of "getting to the point." Lyrics generally are pretty good though.
songs.name: Getting to the Point
Christie Lee
songs.comments: It probably had more meaning to him but to most listeners "Christie Lee" is just a name so it feels very repetitive. Some of the words also don't sound right. Vocal score could potentially be raised.

songs.name: Redbone
songs.comments: An incredibly recognizable instrumental. Gets a bit repetitive towards the second half.

songs.name: Sweet Talkin' Woman
songs.comments: The vast majority of the song is composed of choruses or pre-choruses. There's an unnaturally sharp cut between "no, no, no" and "don't know what I'm gonna do" the first time.

songs.name: Sorry Not Sorry
songs.comments: Not a lot going on in the background. Vocals are hard to place because they stick out so much it's a bit grating but she has good technique and range. I found it a bit repetitive.
It's not quite as bad as it looks but having "ooh" be pretty much the only lyric in the second half isn't great.
songs.album: The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 And Beyond
songs.name: Safe & Sound - from The Hunger Games Soundtrack
4:00A.M.
songs.comments: Instrumental is amazing. Not sure if I like the refrain, it interrupts the flow of the song and suddenly drops the energy. I think her vocals could've used just a bit more energy and emotion. Not a lot in the lyrics. An outro would be nice.
Flow is barely passable. There is building in the background and some variation but still the chorus is repetitive.
songs.name: the words
Enchanted
songs.comments: The song actually builds well to the climax. There's a consistent motion throughout the song too. Everything fits together really well during the peaks at the chorus. The repeated sections have their differences too. Bridge is also good.

songs.name: Under Pressure - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: Overall a pretty odd song with some really good parts. A little all over the place between the scatting, switching singers and different sections. Very hard to score any part of this song.

songs.name: Saturday Night’s Alright (For Fighting) - Remastered 2014
songs.comments: As I'm noticing with many songs, the lyrics fall off in the second half. The slight variations in execution help a bit.

I'm not a fan of this structure rap songs use where they feature an artist to do the repetitive chorus and do all the distinct verses. This is a slightly better example. This one actually follows a consistent theme.
songs.name: Love The Way You Lie

songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but the delivery is different.
songs.name: Gloria
Talking to the Moon
songs.comments: I feel that during the climax of the song the instrumental gets so overwhelming that it takes away the solemn vibe from the start of the song

songs.name: I Go to Extremes

songs.comments: Might just be a preference but I really don't like these vocals. I don't like how some parts just suddenly cut off and it doesn't sound very well supported. I don't like how the song builds as if it's going to climax then just drops.
songs.name: comethru

songs.comments: Slightly repetitive chorus
songs.name: Take Me to Church
Rolling in the Deep
songs.comments: I think the choruses get a little louder each time but it's not super obvious. There's a bit of movement in the background too but I still feel it's not quite enough. It's debatable whether or not the flow score should've been lowered.

Intro is very good. Some lyrics like "golden eagle" and "queen of hearts" feel a bit random because they don't seem to be connected to one theme. The chorus feels a bit out of place. Background, lyrics and cohesion could be scored lower.
songs.name: Past Lives

songs.comments: Very few unique lyrics on this one. A lot of "ooh" and "ahh." The lyrics that are there are pretty good though. The choruses are literally identical though.
songs.album: The World From The Side Of The Moon
songs.name: Home

songs.comments: His entrance feels a little off timed? His technique on some of these turns is very good though. Some parts feel a little off, the bridge is one. It kind of lacks a conclusion too so I deducted from flow.
songs.name: Careless Talk
The Lazy Song
songs.comments: Not sure if it's just my headphones but the percussive sounds are way to loud and stick out. Four repetitions of the chorus is a lot. The first and last are different I guess.

songs.album: We Sing. We Dance. We Steal Things.
songs.comments: Lyrics are lighthearted and whimsical which matches with the song. The outro is great, background vocals especially feel like the missing piece.
songs.name: I'm Yours
Tous les mêmes

songs.name: ゆめうつつ
songs.comments: Don't understand the lyrics but I like the translation and they're all distinct which I like. Flow is a bit unique, the song is split by the temporary pause and there's a shift. It makes the song feel less "together" but the mood change is also interesting.

songs.name: Band On The Run - 2010 Remaster
songs.comments: I think in the intro it would be better if they started lower and went up in the "you"s. The transition between the different parts is pretty cool.

songs.album: The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars (2012 Remaster)
songs.comments: I absolutely love the way this song gradually builds to the climax. Some good lyrics some a bit random, I like the "felt like an actor" line. The end is arguably a little repetitive.
songs.name: Five Years - 2012 Remaster
People Are Strange
songs.comments: Lyrics are a little odd but the real problem is that there are only two real verses that just get repeated. The delivery is changed and the flow of the song has a clear shape.

songs.name: You Make Me Real
songs.comments: It's a little all over the place but I love the raw energy, especially in the vocals.
I don't like how it ends by just repeating the chorus more.
songs.name: Secrets
Apologize

I like the bass a lot. Lyrics aren't great, generally crass or basic.
songs.name: About Damn Time
Turn to Stone

The first half flows really well with the two unique verses but it repeats the post chorus too many times at the end I feel.
songs.name: Don't Walk Away
Roadhouse Blues
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit nonsensical but honestly it would probably work no matter what he was shouting

The music video for this song is incredible. The artist clearly has an emotional connection to what he's singing about. I love how it shifts from confusion to anger to sadness then climaxes and then reaches acceptance

songs.comments: "I want it so fine" is a pretty weird line, and the chorus is just that one line being repeated. The instrumental section is also pretty odd.

songs.name: Once in a Lifetime
La vie en rose - Single Version

songs.name: Heart Attack
Dance With You Tonight
songs.comments: I really like all the little piano riffs in the background. Maybe slight criticism that there are no lyrics in the scat/instrumental bridge which is the only thing between the repeated chorus but the second chorus has a different mood compared to the first.

songs.comments: In the middle of the last chorus it randomly gets really muffled for some reason?

songs.name: All Dead, All Dead - Remastered 2011
Dog Days Are Over
songs.comments: I really like the lyrics and the overall theme of this song. I think vocals, background and cohesion all could be raised too.

songs.comments: The bass is great. The overall feel of the song is great.

songs.name: Can't Get It out of My Head
About You

songs.name: edamame

songs.name: Can't You Hear Me Knocking - 2009 Mix

songs.comments: I cannot believe that this is the drummer singing. His voice is absolutely gorgeous.

songs.comments: I like the lyrics but they also repeat a bit too much for me to raise the score.

Descendants Of The Sun Pt.3 (Original Television Soundtrack)

After The Storm (feat. Tyler, The Creator & Bootsy Collins)

songs.comments: Background feels very basic, could have a lower score. Chorus is very similar aside from a few added parts in the background every time.

songs.name: Saliva

songs.comments: There's a sound at the beginning like someone is chewing metal.

Late Night Talking

songs.name: Here I Go Again - 2018 Remaster
songs.comments: Gets a little repetitive at the end. That high note he hits before the guitar solo is pretty nuts.

songs.name: Remember Summer Days
songs.comments: I like the song but it kind of lacks an overall direction. Some sections are directly repeated.

songs.name: Havana (feat. Young Thug)

songs.album: Love Is a Four Letter Word (Deluxe Edition)

songs.comments: Lyrics are a little cheesy. Still, there is a story.

songs.name: human

songs.comments: I kind of feel like the lower instruments are too quiet on this one
I love the little drum fills. I'll keep saying it though, still too much chorus on all of these songs with no variation. It was a pretty good transition out of the chorus into the ending though

songs.comments: Unreal vocals. I think the key change stuff at the end is interesting but it gets a little repetitive and the fade out ending feels lazy
songs.name: Love On Top

songs.name: There's Always Something There to Remind Me
songs.comments: The song was going somewhere during the line "if you should miss" and then it just killed all motion to go back to the chorus and meander to the end.

songs.name: Someone Like You
songs.comments: The repeating chorus makes up far too much of the song in my opinion

songs.name: Marry You
songs.comments: Chorus repeats too many times in my opinion
There's an electronic sound effect in the background that starts freaking out at the end of some of the choruses and sounds very odd.
songs.name: American Boy

songs.comments: Background vocals in the last chorus are nice. Lyrics feel a little nonsensical and there's nothing particularly special about the structure.
songs.name: Africa

songs.comments: Structure is pretty simplistic, just four verses with choruses between them. I didn't deduct from flow because the song is still dominated by distinct verses.
songs.name: Gorgeous
I Guess That's Why They Call It The Blues

songs.album: Come A Little Bit Closer: The Best Of Jay & The Americans
songs.name: Come A Little Bit Closer

songs.comments: Maybe gets a little repetitive. I didn't deduct anything.
songs.name: New Face
If I Were a Boy
songs.comments: She's obviously an incredible singer. I almost feel that some of the raw emotion the song should've had was lost somewhere. The bridge felt a little awkward. I like how the last chorus changes from "If I were a boy" to "but you're just a boy."

songs.name: R U Mine?
songs.comments: That guitar riff goes pretty hard honestly. The beginning is a bit trippy because it kind of baits you into thinking he's going to come in on a different beat than he does. I like the first verse though. The end of the bridge almost sounds like the outro.

songs.name: Mayonaka no Door / Stay With Me
Brandy (You're a Fine Girl)
songs.comments: I like that the lyrics have a story.

Interesting how the chorus shortens every time. The second chorus is the most confusing, where it goes from "one who understands" to "knows your heart." I kind just don't like how the song has three virtually identical peaks.
songs.name: Only Girl (In The World)

songs.comments: Vocals sound slightly flat. I don't love the structure, there's a short intro and outro and aside from that there are three sections that repeat once each in the same order. There's very little variance.
songs.name: 沉默是金
World's Smallest Violin
songs.comments: I like the theme of the song. Some of the lyrics sound a bit casual, but I suppose that fits with the overall feel of the song? The instrumental breaks are odd. The outro is a really cool concept though.
I really like his flow (lyrical flow and overall song flow are different). The background is actually pretty interesting too, some pretty unique chords there
songs.name: X-Wing - Cold Blooded Soul Version
songs.album: Melt My Eyez See Your Future (The Extended Edition)

songs.name: Money Trees
songs.comments: It sounds like Jay Rock drags a little in his verse. He takes a lot of breaths too. There just isn't a whole lot going on in the background. Rap songs are often like this though, it's just a track put on repeat.

songs.album: Around The World In A Day
songs.name: Raspberry Beret
Love Someone
songs.comments: Kind of repetitive. Vocals kind of stick out a bit. I don't really like the way the last line of the bridge was delivered.

songs.name: See You Again (feat. Charlie Puth)
Barbara Ann
songs.comments: Personally I think the lyrics are kind of a vibe but objectively they are repetitive and nonsensical.

songs.name: Have You Ever Seen The Rain

songs.comments: Some of the lyrics are good but overall there are just a lot of mediocre word choices. "Introvert," "mean," and "crazy bitch" are a few examples. Even the "mmm" instead of an actual word. Some phrases are oddly short.
songs.name: Monster

songs.comments: The melody feels a little all over the place. The lyrics  are also a little awkward. The last line was incredible though, he sounded so heartbroken.
songs.name: In Only Seven Days - Remastered 2011

songs.album: Hooked On A Feeling - 40th Anniversary Collection
songs.comments: Gets pretty repetitive.
songs.name: Hooked On A Feeling
Hey Ya!

Theme is pretty repetitive

Animals

The Best Of Earth, Wind & Fire Vol. 1

songs.comments: Very little variation in the lyrics

The Power Of Love

I Have Nothing

Sunflower - Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

Dreams

Everybody Wants To Rule The World

songs.name: Time in a Bottle

Quite repetitive.

Wildest Dreams

songs.comments: Main criticisms, bridge is a bit random and the song is pretty repetitive. The lyrics are also feels a little random or generic. The song peaks really well.

songs.comments: I wish there were more unique verses man.

songs.name: Escape (The Pina Colada Song)
Cherries Jubiles
songs.comments: The melody is very odd at the beginning and at several points throughout, I reflected that in the deduction to cohesion. I like the bass.

Belize (feat. MF DOOM)

songs.comments: That "craving" stuck out a lot lol. His voice sounds a bit timid, which suits a lot of the song but not some of these aggressive entrances. Some strange choices for the melody at the bridge? I like that I can feel what he was going for.

Dirty Paws

songs.name: Smells Like Teen Spirit
Pursuit Of Happiness (Nightmare)

Seems like a lot of canto pop songs have the formula of slowly adding instruments to make the next chorus peak higher. Not the most revolutionary but definitely not bad.

King

Sunday Morning

Better When You're High

Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009

songs.comments: I like the theme of the lyrics being advice. There are a lot of unique lines.

songs.comments: I like the idea but some of the lyrics feel a little too on the nose maybe? The bridge also messes with the consistent rhythm a bit in my opinion, maybe some kind of a dance break?
songs.name: Born This Way
400 Lux

songs.name: The Way Life's Meant to Be
-Error
songs.comments: You can definitely hear the strain for the high notes but it's still insanely impressive

songs.name: Some Nights

Some of the phrases cut off a bit too sharply in the vocals. It makes the vocals feel a little out of sync with the background during the unique verses. A lot of the lyrics are kind of basic or repetitive.

Last Train to London

I keep hearing "que paso" at the start of the chorus
songs.name: You Were Beautiful
Comin' Home Baby

I like how the instruments get added one by one. Bass drop was pretty underwhelming. Bridge moves into the last chorus well. I like the added backing vocals in the last chorus. Chorus does feel a little out of place and is just lacking bass.

songs.album: A Rush of Blood to the Head
